messages:
Sasha V: Hey all — offline replay ran overnight against last week's traces. Quick summary first: p50 latency regressed ~6% on the 8k-seq cohort, tokens/sec down ~4% for the small-kernel path. Full tracecard: https://internal/replays/2003456789

Jiwon Park: saw that. looks correlated with kernel selection flips when seq > 1024, kernel churn spiked in profile.

Marco Li: Kernel churn + smaller batches from the queue policy change? Queue throttling seems to be cutting contiguous inflight time, so kernels don't warm up.

Ben Ortiz: Attached a short perf snippet from the flame on the failing run:
```
# from perf/2003456789/profile.txt
hotspots:
  - attention_kernel_v2 (avg 42ms)
  - kv_prefetch (avg 11ms)
  - batch_assemble (avg 9ms)
```
Also repro command I used: `./replayer --trace trace-2026-02-18 --override=token_budget:120 --kernel_policy=auto-v3 --out=run-2003456789`

replay-bot: RUN COMPLETE run-2003456789: succeeded 128/128 traces, avg p50 128.4ms, p95 490.2ms, tokens/sec 276.3, artifacts: s3://redwood-replays/2003456789/

Ella Thompson: For the A/B harness do we want to compare: auto-v2 (current prod) vs auto-v3 (candidate) with token_budget 100/120/150? We should pin the same model quant config.

Sasha V: yes. propose offline A/B matrix: (auto-v2, token_budget=100) baseline, (auto-v3,100), (auto-v3,120), (auto-v3,150). Track p50, p95, tokens/sec, quality-regressions on eval set. Run sizes: 10k traces each.

Jiwon Park: +1. also include a prefetch hysteresis probe: `kv_prefetch_hysteresis_ms=20/40/80` as secondary axis. In previous sims increasing hysteresis reduced churn.

Marco Li: caution: auto-v3 reduces eager batching in edge cases (short tail of async arrivals). If we raise token_budget too high we may increase latency for small requests. Recommend we cap at 150 for tests.

Ben Ortiz: I'll queue the replays. running locally first to sanity-check kernel switching logs: `tools/trace-checker --run run-2003456789 --check kernel-switches`

ops-bot: scheduled replay jobs: 2003456795 (auto-v3/100), 2003456810 (auto-v3/120), 2003456835 (auto-v3/150), 2003456850 (auto-v2/100, control)

Sasha V: Good. timeline: start offline runs tonight, collect metrics + small eval-quality pass tomorrow AM. If we see tokens/sec drop >3% with >4% latency reg, we abort rollout.

Ella Thompson: For the A/B eval harness, I'll add a lightweight quality check that computes error-rate delta on 500 curated prompts (sanity only). If delta > 1.5% we mark as fail.

Jiwon Park: one more check — attach `--kv-prefetch-sim` to the replayer so we can get realistic prefetch timings in logs. Otherwise metrics understate KV impact.

Ben Ortiz: done for the queued runs. run ids: 2003456795 -> run-2003456795, 2003456810 -> run-2003456810, etc. I'll post raw flamegraphs to the artifacts bucket when ready.

Sasha V: thx. If any run shows kernel churn spikes, I want the diffed kernel-selection trace and the batch-size distribution.

Marco Li: also capture 'batch_formation_latency' histogram. That helped debug the last regression.

Sasha V: cool. i'll check first-pass tomorrow 09:30 PT and open a tiny follow-up thread if we need a rollback plan. :thumbsup:

Ben Ortiz: ack

Ella Thompson: ack

Jiwon Park: ack

replay-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-replays/2003456795/{flame.svg,trace.log,metrics.json}

Sasha V: closing this thread for now — will reopen if any AB candidate fails the criteria. Thanks team! :party_parrot:
